title: VectOrg Knowledge Base Schema v2.0 (kb_*.json)
description: ADR-0005: 3-object (F.*/P.*/G.*) + registry model. Superset of v0.3.0 (entities[], flat) — both entities[] (legacy) and concepts[]/forms[] (new) may coexist during migration (Phase5). At least one of entities[] or concepts[] is required. New files SHOULD use concepts[] only; entities[] is read/write-compatible for tooling that has not migrated yet.

schemaVersion.description: Replaces v0.3.0's 'version' field. '0.3.0'=legacy flat, '2.0-draft'=migration in progress, '2.0'=concepts[] finalized for this file. v0.3.0 files that only carry `version` are accepted (treated as 0.3.0).

version.description: DEPRECATED alias of schemaVersion, kept for v0.3.0 reader compatibility. If both present, schemaVersion wins.

prefix.description: Entity/concept ID prefix character. Unchanged from v0.3.0.

dimension.description: DEPRECATED single-dimension assumption from v0.3.0 (was: fixed 384). Kept only as the default/primary facet's dim for legacy readers; the authoritative per-facet dims live in concepts[].embeddings[].dim and registry/facets.json.

metric.description: Distance metric for vector search. Unchanged from v0.3.0.

is_sanitized.description: Whether raw source text and external URLs have been cleansed. Unchanged from v0.3.0.

fidelity_score.description: Semantic retention fidelity percentage (0-100), from core/privacy/metrics.mjs. Unchanged from v0.3.0.

source.description: Dataset-level provenance (F.provenance). New in v2, additive.

entities.description: LEGACY v0.3.0 shape. Flat entity list, one item = one concept + one lemma + one embedding, no relations/senses/externalAlignment. New files should not add to this array; use concepts[]/forms[] instead. Retained so unmigrated readers/writers keep working during Phase5.

id.description: Unique identifier for the knowledge entity.

name.description: Canonical term, headword, or standard title.

reading.description: Phonetic reading in Hiragana or Romanized alphabet.

definition.description: Concept definition, explanation, or clinical criteria.

layer.description: Semantic layer index (0 to 9). See registry/facets.json `legacy` field for the facet this maps to.

layerName.description: Standard label of the layer (e.g. 'L4 Semantic', 'L1 Lemma').

code.description: Standard classification code (e.g. 'ICD-10: F32'). Migrates to concepts[].notations[].

synonyms.description: Alternative terms, paraphrases, colloquial expressions. Migrates to concepts[].labels[] (kind=alt).

inEditor.description: DEPRECATED: editor-session UI state accidentally persisted into the compiled artifact. Does not belong in a build output; scheduled to move to vect-or-edit's own local state file. Kept optional for backward compatibility only, ignored by new tooling.

source.description: Source provenance. Migrates to concepts[].labels[].provenance (per-label) or concepts[].provenance (dataset-level).

vector.description: Normalized float vector embedding. v0.3.0 fixed this to 384; v2 no longer enforces a fixed length here (variable dimension, see ADR-0005). Migrates to concepts[].embeddings[0].vector. Optional at authoring time (pre-embedding input such as templates/domain_data.template.json); present after compileData().

forms.description: F.form: lexical entries (lemma-level), new in v2. Independent from concepts; linked via senses[].id. Optional even for v2 files (a concepts-only file with labels[] is valid).

concepts.description: F.concept: concept-centric core, new in v2. Each item is a superset of one v0.3.0 entity.

layer.description: LEGACY compatibility view only. Optional. Range is NOT bounded here; validator checks it against registry/facets.json `legacy` (non-exhaustive design).

version.description: Code-system release, e.g. 'FY2027' for ICD-10-CM (codes change every year; without this, the same value can mean different things).

category.description: DEPRECATED v0.3.0 field, superseded by broader[]/relations[]. Kept for legacy readers.

literal.description: false = idiomatic use where the written form and the actual referent diverge (e.g. 'green light' for a go signal that is not green)

relations.description: generalized relation graph (SKOS broader/narrower + WordNet + ConceptNet)

type.description: Relation type. Open vocabulary: registry/facets.json vocabularies.relationTypes (validated by core/validator.mjs).

source.description: Origin of the edge: 'internal' or a vocabularies.externalSources value.

externalAlignment.description: links to external datasets, no data duplication

source.description: External dataset. Open vocabulary: registry/facets.json vocabularies.externalSources.

modality.description: e.g. 'text' / 'image'. Must match the facet's `modality` in registry/facets.json.

facet.description: registry/facets.json key (F.*/P.*/G.*). Membership is checked by core/validator.mjs, not by this schema.

facetCandidates.description: Set by migration when a legacy layer maps to >1 facet (e.g. L7 -> G.policy/G.rule); requires human resolution.

legacy.description: v0.3.0 fields with no v2 home (e.g. inEditor UI state, raw layerName). Preserved by migration, ignored by new tooling.

stub.description: Synthesized node that closes the broader-hierarchy (e.g. ICD-10-CM category headers absent from the billable-codes file). Title to be filled from an authoritative source.
